# ue-perf-probe-toolset

> Pure core and Unreal adapter of an Unreal MCP toolset that records CSV Profiler captures, computes frame statistics against budgets and reports build size. Python package trysac-ue-perf-probe-toolset, import name ue_perf_probe_toolset, MIT licensed, Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): problem, install, usage example, public API, errors and limits
- [Agent usage](docs/AGENT_USAGE.md): call_tool examples for the PerfProbeTools MCP toolset
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): shape of the package and the capture flow
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): what exists and what has not been run
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model with defended and undefended cases
